quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Single Comma vs. Paired Commas (.)

quests.punctuatedSentence: In my opinion, the new policy goes too far.
quests.ruleExplanation: Since the phrase opens the sentence rather than interrupting it, only one comma is needed after it.
quests.nativeTip: This time, the same kind of phrase appears at the very start of the sentence instead of the middle.

quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Single Comma vs. Paired Commas (.)

quests.punctuatedSentence: The new policy goes too far, in my opinion.
quests.ruleExplanation: Since the phrase now comes at the end of the sentence, only one comma is needed before it.
quests.nativeTip: Now the same phrase appears at the end of the sentence - check how many commas that placement needs.
quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: The new policy goes too far in my opinion ➔ Final: The new policy goes too far, in my opinion.

quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Single Comma vs. Paired Commas (.)

quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Appositives at Sentence Openings (.)

quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: A former Olympic swimmer my neighbor trains at the pool every morning ➔ Final: A former Olympic swimmer, my neighbor trains at the pool every morning.
